evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the error message
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the error message" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the error message
sections.description: Sets the color of the error text shown when an answer fails validation (default red, #FF3B30). Keep it red or another high-contrast warning color so people instantly see that their input was rejected and needs fixing. A clear error keeps them from giving up before they can continue.
